relationship_notes: Croatian handmade high-end effects builder. RED ROX was introduced in 2013; current official effects catalog lists RED ROX and DIKTATOR MKII, while DIKTATOR documents the original predecessor. Preserve original/MKII as separate generations and distinguish dirt from the broader non-dirt catalog.

Croatian builder associated with Kruno Vajda and DryBell. The Engine is a dual-section analog foundation pedal combining British overdrive/distortion with EQ and Rangemaster-style/clean boost functions. Treat it as a dirt/gain hybrid rather than inflating the core fuzz count.

One-person Slovenian builder led by Slobodan. Builder states that enclosures, knobs and switches are custom-designed by him and that pedals are built in Slovenia. Baker's Dozen is the first documented release; Blue Whale is a later Bluesbreaker-style evolution. Do not collapse the two into one family without generation evidence.

One-person Croatian operation associated with Darko Vajda / POLAR AUDIO. Current Drowner documentation places silicon fuzz first in the chain and combines it with bitcrusher and reverb/delay. Keep former PLBR identity as an alias/relationship note during future specimen reconciliation.
